description: Planet presets for the Planetary Climate Sandbox (v1). Values are either verified (with sources) or explicitly marked as assumed.

sources.citation: Solar System calibration table (Venus/Earth/Mars): d (AU), Bond albedo, Teq, Tsurf.
sources.notes: Course reading; in-repo source of table values.

sources.name: docs/specs/demos/planetary_climate_sandbox_demo_spec_narrative.md
sources.citation: Toy greenhouse mapping and tauIR calibration formula.
sources.notes: Defines tauIR = 4 ln(Tsurf/Teq) and Tsurf = Teq * exp(tauIR/4).

sources.name: docs/specs/demos/planetary_climate_sandbox_demo_spec_narrative.md
sources.citation: Exoplanet guidance: albedo and greenhouse are usually unknown; allow an explicitly labeled assumed Earth-like option (A=0.30, tauIR=0.49).
sources.notes: Host star luminosity also defaults to an explicit assumption (lstar_lsun = 1.0) for sandbox exploration.
